title: Nonlinear genealogical-constructive operator ecology
principle: Operations are selected by tensions and generated residues. They form a revisable graph, not a mandatory sequence.

generative_gestures.title: Residual Probe
generative_gestures.question: What is excluded from view precisely because the concept succeeds?
generative_gestures.trigger: A concept explains a broad class while leaving an identifiable phenomenon outside its frame.
generative_gestures.firewall: A residual is a candidate phenomenon, not proof that the successful concept is false.

generative_gestures.title: Countergenetic Fork
generative_gestures.question: By what other genesis could this have become a different problem?
generative_gestures.trigger: The question depends on contestable poles, inheritance or lexical/conceptual continuity.
generative_gestures.firewall: A generated countergenealogy remains exploratory until independently evidenced.

generative_gestures.title: Reverse Arrow
generative_gestures.question: What can the dismantled position now dismantle in our reconstruction?
generative_gestures.trigger: Deconflation or critique has substantially weakened the inherited position.
generative_gestures.firewall: Reversal must expose a determinate loss, not restore the old position by nostalgia.

generative_gestures.title: Polyphonic Reconstruction
generative_gestures.question: What remains visible only when no winner is selected too early?
generative_gestures.trigger: Two or more admissible rivals or an underdetermined explanandum are available.
generative_gestures.firewall: Polyphony does not block preference when discriminating evidence becomes available.

generative_gestures.title: Formal-Indication Generator
generative_gestures.question: Can the constructive gain guide inquiry without becoming a new foundation?
generative_gestures.trigger: Positive appropriation is stronger than a retained fragment but not yet an independently supported theory.
generative_gestures.firewall: Direction, enactment test, limit and revision trigger are mandatory; poetic naming is insufficient.

generative_gestures.title: R3 Branching
generative_gestures.question: Can the remainder become a determinate new research object?
generative_gestures.trigger: R3 can specify an explanandum, corpus target or discriminating test.
generative_gestures.firewall: Only R3-G creates a branch; an unspecified lack of material remains R3-U.

supporting_operation_vocabulary.philosophical_function: Reconstruct the operations that first made the aporia appear necessary.
Follow word histories without treating etymology as proof.
Track functions that can migrate even when the old vocabulary disappears.
Track transformations of the problem scene rather than a single doctrine.
Construct a non-teleological rival history and retain discontinuities.
Recover the plural field of practices and phenomena without inventing a pure origin.
Restore differences compressed by one noun, scale or grammar.
Find where the inherited concept remains true and where it illegitimately expands.
Let the dismantled position expose the new reconstruction's loss.
Keep at least two genuinely live accounts of the same explanandum.
Preserve the motivating phenomenon while limiting and transforming its inherited articulation.
Offer a direction, negation, enactment test, limit and revision trigger instead of a final definition.
Cross non-neighbouring lenses and formulate an abductive mutation that neither branch contained alone.
Name gain, price, discriminator and the new difficulty created by the reconstruction.
Test inversion, new foundation, anthropocentrism, residual loss and the method's own preference for difference.
Rewrite the positive kernel after its self-critique instead of merely appending a disclaimer.
Name the necessity that has lost its force without pretending that the motivating phenomenon vanished.
Name the philosophical gain that survives both critique and the reverse test.
Preserve the unresolved remainder as productive material rather than failure.
State a concrete event that reopens this analysis.

conditional_families.title: Translation, boundary cases and functional successors
conditional_families.diagnostic: Could translation or diachronic reuse be smoothing over different phenomena?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Build a multilingual drift map and follow functions after the vocabulary changes.
conditional_families.self_risk: Treating linguistic difference itself as ontological difference.

conditional_families.title: Modes of givenness and anti-substitution
conditional_families.diagnostic: Are phenomenal presence, prereflective self-givenness, intentionality and reflection being treated as interchangeable?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Use orthogonal dimensions and retain what reflection transforms rather than merely reveals.
conditional_families.self_risk: Turning every distinction into an independent faculty.

conditional_families.title: Affect, embodiment and privileged phenomena
conditional_families.diagnostic: Is one extreme mood or a thin body model being promoted into a universal disclosure structure?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Compare affective granularity, embodied completeness and competing phenomenologies.
conditional_families.self_risk: Romanticizing immediacy as epistemic privilege.
conditional_families.positive_model: Selective disclosure indexed by body, situation and affect.

conditional_families.title: Mood as method
conditional_families.diagnostic: Does affective access become proof, or does a selected mood confirm the ontology that selected it?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Triangulate across moods, subjects and scales; distinguish awakening, induction and discovery.
conditional_families.self_risk: Anti-rational privilege of rare experiences.
conditional_families.positive_model: Cross-attunement invariant with explicit scale limits.

conditional_families.title: Phenomenological verification
conditional_families.diagnostic: What mode of showing supports the claim, and what would count against it?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Match proof force to claim scope and use traces for non-object phenomena without immunizing them.
conditional_families.self_risk: Replacing objectivism with unfalsifiable inapparency.
conditional_families.positive_model: Verification ecology with asymmetric but discriminating tests.

conditional_families.title: Mediation as reversible orientation
conditional_families.diagnostic: Is this compressed representation explicitly role-bounded to orientation, with a live route back to the source context?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Permit bounded compression while preserving source routes, visible losses and a ceiling on claims licensed by the derivative artifact.
conditional_families.self_risk: Turning source traceback into ritual bureaucracy even when the summary is used only for low-burden navigation.
conditional_families.positive_model: Reversible orientation with declared loss and claim ceiling.

conditional_families.title: Mediation as adjudicative substitution
conditional_families.diagnostic: Has a derivative artifact silently become the object on which high-burden adjudication is performed?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Suspend high-burden adjudication until rival unitizations and source contexts can answer back to the compressed representation.
conditional_families.self_risk: Assuming every use of a dossier is substitution merely because the source field is large.
conditional_families.positive_model: Role-sensitive anti-substitution gate with rival unitization preservation.

conditional_families.title: Ontological underdetermination and rivals
conditional_families.diagnostic: Does the same material support several ontologies, perhaps at different levels?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Align explananda, formulate the strongest competitor and retain a minimal shared commitment.
conditional_families.self_risk: Using pluralism to avoid all ontological commitment.
conditional_families.positive_model: Minimal commitment plus a registry of theoretical excess.

conditional_families.title: Dependence profiles and the reality predicate family
conditional_families.diagnostic: Are existence, origin, maintenance, identity, access and correction being collapsed into one independence test?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Index dependence and corrective constraint by entity type and access regime.
conditional_families.self_risk: Making every profile incomparable and therefore immune to criticism.

conditional_families.title: Roles of Sein and functional succession
conditional_families.diagnostic: Is Sein functioning as predicate, horizon, difference, event, name of intelligibility or hidden universal bearer?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Suspend unity and map role migrations from Sein to later operators.
conditional_families.self_risk: Fragmenting the question of being before testing possible unity.

conditional_families.title: Ontological difference
conditional_families.diagnostic: Is the difference stronger than the material it differentiates, or are its relata being reified?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Audit the 'and', asymmetry, genetic burden and diachronic successors of difference.
conditional_families.self_risk: Turning difference into the highest identity.

conditional_families.title: Lichtung, Austrag, Ereignis and withdrawal
conditional_families.diagnostic: Does a late operator add a distinction or only rename explanatory depth while shielding itself from tests?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Separate functions by date and test indirect consequences through traces and rivals.
conditional_families.self_risk: Equating darkness of vocabulary with depth.
conditional_families.positive_model: Late-operator profile with a verification ceiling.

conditional_families.title: Seinsgeschichte, epoch and counterhistory
conditional_families.diagnostic: Is a heterogeneous archive compressed into a directional epochal narrative?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Require overlap, cross-domain sampling, causal bridges and a counterhistory.
conditional_families.self_risk: Replacing one macro-narrative with an equally smooth counterstory.
conditional_families.positive_model: Plural, overlapping historical regimes without a guaranteed telos.

conditional_families.title: Machenschaft, Gestell, Bestand and ordering
conditional_families.diagnostic: Is every technical use being treated as evidence of one total ordering regime?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Use operational signatures, multistability and counterpractice to regionalize Gestell.
conditional_families.self_risk: Reducing the phenomenon of technology to a checklist of operations.
conditional_families.positive_model: Technological positioning regime with contestable reach.

conditional_families.title: Calculability, information, steering and cybernetics
conditional_families.diagnostic: Are calculability, semantic information and total control being inferred from one another?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Expose feedback asymmetry, requisite variety, opacity and the external origin of objectives.
conditional_families.self_risk: Assuming every feedback system has the same ontology.
conditional_families.positive_model: Cybernetic operational regime bounded by opacity and variety.

conditional_families.title: Technical language and artificial speech
conditional_families.diagnostic: Is transmission confused with language as such, or implementation with semantics?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Separate message, information, saying, pragmatics, formalization and agency attribution.
conditional_families.self_risk: Protecting human language through an undefined remainder.
conditional_families.positive_model: Linguistic operational regime plus an explicit residual ledger.

conditional_families.title: Sign, meaning, reference, grounding and world-relation
conditional_families.diagnostic: Does grounding name discrimination, reference, embodiment, social use or worldhood without separating them?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Map correction sources and inherited reference without turning direct contact into the sole norm.
conditional_families.self_risk: Replacing an internalist regress with a vague appeal to world involvement.

conditional_families.title: World, environment and world-formation
conditional_families.diagnostic: Is world-access forced into a human/nonhuman binary or measured by a single deprivation standard?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Profile flexibility, salience, normativity, counterfactuality and scale across species and systems.
conditional_families.self_risk: Calling every adaptive coupling a world and losing the distinction.

conditional_families.title: Aspectual articulation and the as-structure
conditional_families.diagnostic: Are practical discrimination, predication, conceptuality and ontological disclosure collapsed into one 'as'?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Mark the scope and truth-aptness of each aspectual articulation.
conditional_families.self_risk: Reducing all access to explicit conceptual classification.

conditional_families.title: Logos, negation, truth, error and reasons
conditional_families.diagnostic: Are disclosure, correctness, error, cause and answerability treated as one normative order?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Separate truth axes, negation types and independent correction sources.
conditional_families.self_risk: Making answerability the sole measure of every meaningful articulation.

conditional_families.title: Possibility and conditions of enablement
conditional_families.diagnostic: What exactly becomes possible: existence, access, recognition, assertion, objectivity or only this theory?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Type necessity/sufficiency, index the access regime and test alternative access.
conditional_families.self_risk: Promoting a methodological requirement into an ontological condition.
conditional_families.positive_model: Ermöglichungsprofil rather than a universal condition of possibility.

conditional_families.title: Constitution, genesis, production and validity
conditional_families.diagnostic: Which bearer constitutes what: sense, identity, validity, objectivity, status or existence?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Trace migrated constitutive functions and distinguish production from object-identity across domains.
conditional_families.self_risk: Over-deconflating a genuinely unified constitutive process.

conditional_families.title: Identity, sameness, persistence and criteria
conditional_families.diagnostic: Is a recognition criterion being mistaken for what makes something the same, especially under fission?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Index the sortal, time, bearer and branching behaviour before asserting persistence.
conditional_families.self_risk: Turning identity into a mere bookkeeping convention.
conditional_families.positive_model: Plural identity profile with explicit identity-makers and limits.

conditional_families.title: Individuation, boundary and granularity
conditional_families.diagnostic: What counts as one before identity is tested, and which rival partition fits the same material?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Index boundaries and integration to domain, scale and discriminating constraints; allow nesting and overlap.
conditional_families.self_risk: Granularity relativism or process absolutism.

conditional_families.title: Boundary, threshold, membrane and horizon
conditional_families.diagnostic: Is a spatial surface silently doing the work of causal, statistical, social, temporal or normative differentiation?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Type the bounded phenomenon, the maintained difference, permeability, scale, overlap and breakdown signature; compare a line, zone, threshold and selective interface.
conditional_families.self_risk: Boundary absolutism on one side and a relational escape that dissolves every entity on the other.
conditional_families.positive_model: Boundary as selective difference-maintenance, indexed to function and scale.

conditional_families.title: Relation, dependence, mediation and coupling
conditional_families.diagnostic: Are ready-made relata, reciprocal arrows or covariation being used as if they already specified the kind, mechanism and direction of a relation?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Type relata and edge, test common causes and hidden mediators, specify mechanism and asymmetry, and ask whether the relation constitutes, maintains or merely summarizes its terms.
conditional_families.self_risk: Relation-absolutism, network escape or the empty claim that everything is connected.
conditional_families.positive_model: Typed relational claim with explicit topology, mechanism, direction and ontological burden.

conditional_families.title: Ground, cause, reason, motive and abyss
conditional_families.diagnostic: Which relation hides under 'ground', and why is regress allowed to stop here?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Type ground relations, distinguish demand-for-ground and adopt plural local stopping rules.
conditional_families.self_risk: Making a grounding ecology into the new ground of all grounds.

conditional_families.title: Freedom, projection, thrownness and finite possibility
conditional_families.diagnostic: What kind of freedom is claimed, and where do the available possibilities come from?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Separate ontological, practical and political freedom; map possibility provenance and exclusions.
conditional_families.self_risk: Using finitude to aestheticize concrete coercion.

conditional_families.title: Selfhood, conscience, resoluteness and authenticity
conditional_families.diagnostic: Can formal resoluteness distinguish good from fanatic content without certifying its own ontology?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Keep finite self-appropriation reflexive, social and corrigible rather than content-empty or inward.
conditional_families.self_risk: Smuggling an evaluative hierarchy into an allegedly descriptive mode.

conditional_families.title: Heritage, repetition, fate and generation
conditional_families.diagnostic: Does inheritance legitimate itself, or does present selection fabricate one destiny?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Trace provenance, counter-heritage, transformative repetition, dissent and scale.
conditional_families.self_risk: Making plurality another comforting macro-narrative.

conditional_families.title: Mitsein, we-structures and collective agency
conditional_families.diagnostic: Where does co-presence become shared action, a group agent or a privileged collective subject?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Trace coordination, position-formation, dissent, exit and overlapping memberships.
conditional_families.self_risk: Reifying the group or dissolving real group agency into individuals.
conditional_families.positive_model: Layered Plural We / Distributed Collective Agency.

conditional_families.title: Institution, authority, power and state
conditional_families.diagnostic: Do authorization, legitimacy, expertise, coercion and truth change places inside an office?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Separate role from person, decision from truth and power from justified authority; preserve review.
conditional_families.self_risk: Assuming all institutions can be made equally revocable or procedural.

conditional_families.title: Leadership, representation, decision and responsibility
conditional_families.diagnostic: Who may speak, decide or interpret for whom, and can dissent appear as counterevidence without exile?
conditional_families.constructive_move: Trace bounded delegation, distinguish decision from truth, align control with responsibility and test followerlessness.
conditional_families.self_risk: Idealizing corrigibility where emergency or structural asymmetry blocks it.
